Degree lane, W5: the degree homomorphism on the Čech Picard group and the E-i..E-iii interface. classDeg : Additive Pic(X) →+ ℤ — the degree of any divisor presenting the class, well-defined because equal classes differ by a principal divisor (extraction) and principal divisors have degree zero (the χ-ledger), total by surjectivity; carrier chosen so values are honest integers with the hom laws free (an AddMonoidHom out of the additivized Picard group rather than Multiplicative-ℤ wrappers). E-i: classDeg [𝒪(D)] = deg D for every Weil divisor. E-ii: classDeg (L·L') = classDeg L + classDeg L'. E-iii: χ(𝒪(D)) = χ(𝒪) + classDeg [𝒪(D)], with the finiteness-free class-invariance χ(𝒪(D)) = χ(𝒪(D')) whenever [𝒪(D)] = [𝒪(D')] (extraction + the multiplication isomorphism + χ-transport — no choice anywhere). Curve form: χ(𝒪(D)) = 1 − genus C + classDeg [𝒪(D)] on the challenge curve, side-condition-free. The two structure-sheaf finiteness hypotheses ride exactly where the ledger needs them; the pushforward-rank reading of E-i deferred as its own statement.
